title: ADV350 Maxi (Race Replica)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Honda ADV350 Maxi (Race Replica) is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. At its heart lies a 350cc powertrain delivering 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 163 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 13.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
